title: Event120 supplied source corpus coverage

gate.scope: All unique text bodies supplied in project_sources and upload, including every nested archive member
gate.method: Every unique source body fully read in model-visible outputs by root or assigned source reviewers. Exact duplicates counted once only after SHA-256 equivalence. No unread or unrecovered truncated source bodies. Root separately reviewed all specialist findings.
gate.attestation_basis: Contemporaneous complete reader ledgers and the parent completion record. The final audit rechecks source identity, provenance and range completeness.

portable_path_convention.meaning: Paths identify supplied source origins. They are descriptive provenance references and do not assert that source bodies or archives are contained in the deliverable package.

method: Recomputed SHA-256 and byte lengths from every original top-level source and every recursively opened ZIP member
Compared each original member byte for byte with its extraction copy
Compared every same-hash provenance instance byte for byte
Recounted lines from UTF-8 text with optional BOM removed using splitlines
Matched each completed gate record against its actual reader ledger
Checked character and line coverage for complete extents and no gaps under each recorded coordinate convention
Reconciled original assignments and completed reading ownership
verification.hashing_role: Administrative integrity verification. Full reading is separately attested by the reader ledgers.

root.character_basis: UTF-8 decoded source with any BOM retained and original newline characters retained
root.note: The ledger records character chunk boundaries and an aggregate complete line range. It does not record a separate line range for each character chunk.

A.character_basis: UTF-8 decoded text with an optional BOM removed and universal newline normalization
A.note: CRLF and CR become LF for display coordinates. Original bytes remain the hash basis.

B.character_basis: UTF-8 decoded text with any BOM retained and universal newline normalization
B.note: The source_characters field describes decoded source length. displayed_character_ranges describes normalized display length. A chunk can split a line, so adjacent line ranges can share that line.

C.character_basis: UTF-8 decoded source with any BOM retained and original newline characters retained
C.note: The ledger records character chunk boundaries and an aggregate complete line range. Its queue 10 note separately records universal newline rendering for that full-file display.

truncation_recoveries.recovery: The initial truncated AGENTS output was superseded by a complete model-visible reread. The final ledger records characters [0, 44418) and lines 1 through 431.
truncation_recoveries.ledger_note_scope: The same AGENTS recovery note appears on each of the 23 original root records. It describes the AGENTS recovery and does not assert that all 23 bodies were truncated.

truncation_recoveries.recovery: The first batch 18 output exceeded available model context. A took no credit for it and reread the entire batch after compaction. The successful output was recorded as 10157 tokens with a 16000 token output allowance.

assignment_transfers_and_retained_owners.note: B records no reading credit for these transferred bodies. Root records the complete reads.
C explicitly marked these bodies unread by C and transferred them to root.
A excluded queue 115 from batch 20 and recorded no read ranges. Root supplied the complete read.
B first transferred the body to root. Root reassigned it to A before a read was claimed. A read both complete chunks and persisted the extra coverage before the global gate passed.
A had already fully read these three bodies before root proposed taking ownership. The completed gate retains A as the actual reader and credits no root reread.

Source bodies, source archives, internal planning scratch files and review plans are not embedded in this evidence
